title: SM-ACC-001: general accounting scope and immutable balanced journal foundation
authority: Owner 2026-10-03 requests merging the new and previous prompts, applying project changes, then explicitly directs a general accounting application for all business categories. Persistent owner authorization permits reviewed merges after checks.
scope: Adopt sector-neutral accounting-first scope and implement chart accounts plus atomic balanced journal posting, durable replay and explicit reversal without POS/device/shift dependencies.
out_of_scope: Sales/invoices/receivables/payables/period close/full reports, POS/catalog/offline implementation, fiscal provider, physical devices and production. Existing PRs 11/12 stay independent.
task: Merge accepted requirements without deleting POS-001..150; update only canonical roadmap; add scoped accounting domain/migration/RBAC/API and immutable balanced journal regressions.
validation: Local schema/money/hash unit tests, backend lint and typing, packet/adoption validation; disposable PostgreSQL concurrency/rollback/immutability/tenant/branch API tests and migration roundtrip; exact-source Foundation and Governance CI; complete same-session diff review.
stop_conditions: Source mismatch, unexpected overlapping application work, financial/tenant regression, secret exposure, failed required checks.
success_criteria: General accounting works without terminals/shifts; only balanced authorized tenant-safe journals commit; request replay and reversal do not duplicate; DB blocks posted record mutation; old POS rules remain traceable; no full accounting/production readiness claim.

merge.reference: Persistent owner project instruction grants reviewed merges after requirements succeed; current 2026-10-03 instruction authorizes application of the merged general-accounting scope.
